title: Candle Mage Ritual
description: A hooded figure in a green patterned robe stands holding a melting candle with dripping wax. The character has a stylized pink and green mask-like face, one hand raised in a gesture while a large glowing circular sigil filled with arcane symbols floats behind them against a mountain landscape at sunset.
prompt: A mysterious hooded mage wearing a flowing green robe covered in yellow triangular symbols, standing in front of dark mountains under a green and pink gradient sky. The figure has a stylized pink and green mask for a face, holds a tall melting candle with dripping wax in one hand while raising the other in a ritual gesture. A large circular magical sigil with glowing yellow arcane symbols floats behind them. Dramatic atmosphere with swirling mist, digital illustration style.
